## Damnation Book (CR 4)

**XP** 1,200  
LE Small undead  
**Init** +3 **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +3  


**Defense**


**AC** 14, touch 14, flat-footed 11 (+3 Dex, +1 size)  
**hp** 50 (5d8+10)  
**Fort** +3, **Ref** +4, **Will** +7  
**Immune** undead immunities  
**Vulnerable** fire  


**Offense**


**Speed** flight 60 ft. (perfect)  
**Melee** +6 bite (1d4-1 piercing plus energy drain)  
**Special Attacks** energy Drain (1 level, Fort DC 14)  
**Spellcasting** (CL 5th, Concentration +18 DC 16; the Damnation Book casts spells as a wizard of its total Hit Dice, typically fifth-level.  

3rd—ray of exhaustion (prepared twice, Fort DC 19)  
2nd—dust of twilight, false life, scare (prepared twice, Will DC 18)  
1st—cause fear (prepared twice, Will DC 17), ray of enfeeblement (prepared twice, Fort DC 17), summon monster I  
Cantrips—bleed, daze, mage hand, touch of fatigue  


**Statistics**


**Str** 9, **Dex** 16, Con—, **Int** 22, **Wis** 16, **Cha** 15  
**Base Atk** +3; **CMB** +2; **CMD** 15 (immune to trip)  
**Feats** Combat Casting, Fly-By Attack, Hover, Weapon Finesse  
**Skills** Fly +19, Knowledge (arcana, history, at least 5 others) +14, Linguistics +14, Stealth +8, Spellcraft +14  
**Languages** Abyssal, Common, Draconic, Infernal, various others  



**Ecology**


**Environment** urban or ruins  
**Organization** solitary or in flocks of up to 1d6+1 (often called a collection), or enormous flocks of up to 20-30 (called a library)  
**Treasure** standard (in lair)
